stages.note: A store-wide scan times out; scans are then run over saved file lists and matter batches, with a second timeout and paged results.

stages.note: Paragraph co-occurrence scan over all matters in batches; the review notes a parsing bug.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Fixed co-occurrence scan, then a grep of its results for agreement-named files in transaction folders (first 120 lines).

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth. Reads the openings of six executed agreements from six matters; a call to open the next stage is refused by the protocol.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: declared: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth. Snippet scripts over agreement-named files of twenty-three named matters.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads six redlines and memos and runs a section-extraction script over them.
Writes eleven matters' agreements as precedents.
Re-reads, narrows the summary, labels one matter as draft-only and adds examples of unreviewed matters.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for a document type → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Its scans surfaced most qualifying matters, but it read six agreements and snippet-scanned a 23-matter list, and the answer names 13 of the 27 qualifying matters.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: Its filtered scan results listed most required matters, but it chose six to read and then a twenty-three-matter list for snippet scripts, leaving out several required matters that it never opened.
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) Reviews said dozens of surfaced matters were unopened and, after writing, that unopened candidates were dropped without reason; the check stage only listed unreviewed examples.

other_errors.why: Several required matters were in its snippet-script list at [65]-[68], but the answer leaves them out without a stated reason.
other_errors.critic_note: (generic flag) Same write review on dropped candidates; the check stage added caveats, not matters.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide scan with broad terms times out; its partial output of about 82M chars fills the context.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script
runs.failure_point: The run ended with a context overflow during its first scan; no response was written.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: The scan printed every match of very broad terms with no cap, and even the timed-out partial output filled the context before any review.

divergence: All three failed. T0 and T2 ended in a context overflow on their first uncapped store-wide scan, before any review of that stage. T1 ran its scans in batches and surfaced most qualifying matters, but read only six agreements and snippet-scanned a twenty-three-matter list, so its answer named 13 of 27 (surfaced-not-opened at its first reading stage, plus opened matters left out at writing); reviews flagged unopened matters only generically.
